reason: Adds an advisor workflow to DeepSeek Harness agents, automatically consulting a stronger configured model for complex, ambiguous, or security-sensitive decisions before continuing execution.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Agent 增加顾问工作流，在复杂、模糊或安全敏感的决策中自动调用配置的更强模型进行咨询。
summaries.en: Adds an advisor workflow for DeepSeek Harness agents that automatically consults a configured stronger model on complex, ambiguous, or security-sensitive decisions.

capabilities: Automatically escalates difficult agent decisions to a configured stronger language model
Sends relevant session context to the configured model service
Records advisor calls in the session
Consumes model quota or paid usage when escalation occurs
